subject: beodeul grass 737 r2 body (unglyph), rows from grass-body-r2.json

glyphs.notes: 8x re-upscale of a 6x4-tile field crop: the old 'Sng/ULL' dark clusters are gone; largest marks are 2-px pairs and 2-3 px vertical blades, no stroke-like or letter-like shapes. Wrapped 2x2 of the rows also shows no glyph across tile borders.

regular_pattern.notes: At 1x and 3x the field reads as fine even grass speckle. A faint 16px repetition is perceptible at 3x on a pure 20x15 field (unavoidable for a single repeating tile) but there is no dashed line, mesh grid or diagonal weave. Minor: row 2 has only one mark and row 7 two, making a slightly sparser horizontal band every 16px; not visible as a stripe at 1x/3x. Column marks 2-7 per column, no dominant column.

seams.notes: Wrap check: row15->row0 and col15->col0 neighbours form at most a light-over-dark blade (col 0 rows 6-8 b,b,a), no doubled lines or hard edges at 16px borders in field-3x or the 8x upscale.

edges.notes: Village crops 1-4: grass meets cobble roads, plaza paving, forest canopy/shadows and bush shadows without visible breaks; edge tiles 736/548/740-742/748/749 in tiles-8x keep their prior structure (shadow corner on 548/740 unchanged) with the body swapped in place.

density_style.notes: Same four greens, low contrast, comparable density to the flower/dotted variants 743/745 neighbours; at village 1x the ground reads as calm natural grass consistent with the beodeul trees and props.

regression.notes: Versus before: removes the repeating dark letter clusters; overall value and hue unchanged, no new artefacts in variants or edges.

reasons: No mesh/dash/weave; only inherent 16px tile repetition
No seams or edge breaks in village crops
Palette/density consistent with surrounding art; clear improvement over before
